response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Toyota alternator with model number 28100-12110, visible in both photos. While the seller claims 'highest grade and quality with guarantee', this cannot be verified remotely. The item is priced at its worst case: as a used, untested alternator, with risks of non-functionality or damage. The photos show wear but no obvious breakage, so it is not unidentifiable or fraudulent.
